failureRules: The opaque object key is server-generated, stored only in the database and never returned by DTOs.
Upload authorization is random, hashed at rest, session-bound, and scoped to the attachment, method, declared size, digest and expiry.
File fsync and atomic rename happen before FILE_STAGED; retrying complete can publish READY after a process crash.
Files are not removed by age or mtime; GC requires DELAYED GC_PENDING state, lease, and no explicit reference or live upload authorization.
A released file remains available to later references only if its reference was retained before DELETE; RESTORE/SNAPSHOT integration is not implemented.
